inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Each chromosome painted a distinct color by chromosome-specific probes — translocations appear as two-tone chromosomes

notes: The G-banded karyogram is an original KYP schematic redraw (stylized banded homologous pairs 1–22 + X/Y with red abnormality arrows, matching the source's cancer-cell annotation) — the diagnostic identity (banded-pair layout with abnormality arrows) is preserved without reproducing the photomicrograph. The SKY visual is a KYP adaptation preserving the source's painted-pair concept and its three named readouts (the 17;19 unbalanced translocation as a two-color chromosome, the chromosome-8 duplication as an extra same-color copy, and the microdeletion as a missing fluorescent stretch on one homolog).
